text.p: Buckle Inc said Thursday its comparable store sales for the four-week period ended February 1 were up 10.7 percent compared with a year ago.
Total sales for the four-week period increased 21.4 percent to $10.8 million from $8.9 million.
Net sales year-to-date, for the 52 weeks ended February 1, increased 21.1 percent to $206.4 million from $170.3 million. Comparable sales for the year-to-date period were up 11.1 percent.

When compared to the 53-week retail calendar in fiscal 1995, net sales fo the 52 weeks of fiscal 1996 increased by 19.8 percent to $206.4 million from $172.3 million. Same store sales for the 52 weeks of fiscal 1996 were up 9.8 percent from the 53 weeks of fiscal 1995.
